# Cliff Heroes

> A real-time PvP climbing game for mobile. Four climbers race up the same
> procedurally-shifting wall at once, using smoke bombs, grip-traps and alt
> loadouts to reach the summit first. Currently pre-launch, taking wishlist
> signups for early access.

- Platforms: iOS, Android
- Studio: OffStars Studios
- Status: unreleased, early access via wishlist
- Site: https://cliffheroes.com/

## Game

- Race to the Summit: four climbers scale the same procedurally-shifting
  ascent simultaneously. Read the wall, chain grips, out-pace rivals.
- Smoke, Traps & Sabotage: every climber carries a kit. Lob smoke bombs to
  blind the pack, drop grip-traps below you, unlock alt loadouts by ranking
  up across the season.

## News

- Cliff Heroes Is Coming Soon: the game is in development for mobile and the
  wishlist is open. https://cliffheroes.com/news/coming-soon
- Season 0 Closed Beta Opens: early access rolls out by region.
  https://cliffheroes.com/news/season-0-closed-beta
- New Climber: Pedro the Alchemist: a support-saboteur built around denial.
  https://cliffheroes.com/news/pedro-the-alchemist

## Notes

- Wishlist members get early access first.
